mike_p: Quick sync — EdgeHub (HW partner) just sent a usage contract asking to push minutely gzipped JSONL to their S3 + nightly checksum. We prefer signed webhooks/streaming. Can we accept S3 for initial onboarding? Need to align on: schema, timestamp semantics (UTC epoch), signature verification, idempotency, backfill window, SKU->billing mapping, and a minimal smoke-test plan.

sara_pm: I'm ok with S3 for onboarding only if we run shadow mode (no billing) for 10 business days and require a signed manifest (file list + HMAC) per hour. Partner must provide negative test files (duplicate rows, missing fields, late arrivals).

raj_eng: Engineering constraints: file names must be deterministic (partner-yyyyMMdd-HH.jsonl.gz). Manifest.json lists files + X-Manifest-Signature header (HMAC-SHA256). Row schema (JSON): partner_id, sku_id, usage_epoch_utc, quantity, unit, row_id (or compute sha256(row) as row_id). Use epoch seconds UTC only. Backfill tolerance: accept late arrivals up to 72h in shadow, 48h in prod. If manifest missing/invalid -> reject and alert.

jess_ops: Billing needs: sku_id -> billing_dimension (seats|device_minutes|requests) + required_fields (seat_count etc). If required field missing mark NEED_RECON and exclude from auto-invoice. Nightly recon job should surface NEED_RECON to ops-staging with sample rows and a charge-hold toggle. Also define proration rules (device-minutes round up, seats proration by day).

anna_legal: Legal items: retention (raw payloads + manifests 12 months, audit logs 3 years), forbid plaintext PII in payloads (allow hashed ids), include audit rights and indemnity for corrupted usage causing misbilling. Need SOW redline.

mike_p: Owners and deadlines: raj_eng -> ingestion spec + 3 sample sets (clean/dupe/corrupt) by EOD (+6h); sara_pm -> acceptance checklist & smoke-tests by tomorrow; jess_ops -> sku mapping + nightly recon design by day after; anna_legal -> SOW redline by EOW.

sara_pm: I'll add DST cutover tests, out-of-order timestamps, and a small csv/jsonl->webhook converter script for partner validation.

raj_eng: Adding monitoring signals: partner.ingest.latency, partner.parse.errors/hr, partner.duplicate.rows/hr, partner.missing.manifest. Alert on parse_errors > 5/hr.

jess_ops: I'll draft the recon playbook and add a Slack alert with sample rows for ops review. Charge-hold toggle to prevent billing during pilot.

deploy-bot: scheduled: edgehub-ingest-shadow -> tomorrow 09:00 PST (staging).

mike_p: Can everyone meet these deadlines? I'll schedule 30m signoff Thurs 10am to approve pilot window and partner messaging.

sara_pm: Confirmed.

raj_eng: Confirmed.

jess_ops: Confirmed.

anna_legal: Confirmed; will upload redline.

mike_p: Thanks — I'll tell EdgeHub to hold off on production until signoff complete.
